notes.title: An update on the launch of The Perfect Pencil
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/44f80f1e4a1a487b6fbe300a42290c19a76eafb6.jpg"]

Hi everyone,

first of all, we wanted to thank you for the incredible support and enthusiasm you've shown for The Perfect Pencil since its announcement. Reading your comments and seeing your reactions is the biggest motivation for our team.

Today, we are sharing an important update on our journey toward launch.

With the end of summer, we've taken stock of the development progress and carefully went over the release schedule for the coming months. As you know, our goal has always been to present you with The Perfect Pencil at its the best, in order to offer you an experience you won't forget.

The fall release landscape is shaping up to be incredibly packed with fantastic games, many of which we can't wait to play ourselves.

For this very reason, and to ensure that The Perfect Pencil meets the highest quality standards and gets the space and attention it deserves, we have made the strategic decision to move the launch window to early 2026.

This was not an easy choice for us, but we believe that it is the best one for our game and for you, our community.

The extra time gives us a valuable opportunity: it will allow us not only to polish the game, but to also integrate at launch new features and content that we had originally planned for the post-launch support. The result will be a richer and more complete game for you to enjoy from day one.

Thank you again for your patience and understanding. We really believe that we are creating something special, and we can't wait to show you!

notes.title: Meet Gaston - Dev Blog #4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/b810fe68fde0531b4164787577c84bc221eaaf61.gif

"Hello, I'm Gaston, the official doorman of Clemensburg, the most charming town in the kingdom of the White Beast.

Our town offers to a select few the warm and reassuring comfort of "genuine" companionship.

Thanks to that and our fabulous mentor, we're shielded from the terrifying banks of fog surrounding our sparkling walls."


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/59193ce6abff0f086c05e45007a8076164072b19.gif
(One of my favorites activities)


"We all know what hides behind those banks... and you don't want to get stuck in them, lost in confusion and yourself.

So, I hope you'll be up to my standards when you knock on my door.

Actually, I don't mind if you don't; If someone's not up to my standards it always makes me feel better about myself."


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/9b84ba10a18f04b4211c60f0efc1f85f9796f172.jpg


"My distinctive features include eyebrows that not only meet but form a perfect circle on my forehead. While I find them superb, a guy with a fanny pack who sneaked into town says I resemble a frog-burger, whatever that means.

My folder keeps track of the upcoming appointments for new citizens who haven't received their social status yet. It accompanies me in every shift of my beloved job, elevating me just enough to feel comfortable.

I'm a rather simple man and don't ask for much more.

My leg? A relic of an encounter with someone who thought they had a higher social status than me; naturally, they were put back in their shameful place."


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/599b41e8745b6d444065da15265329c49c8746c3.gif


Gaston is a chubby and slimy gentleman, dressed in classic fashion like all the other characters, giving them a timeless feel. Each area has a distinctive palette, also used to color other characters. 

Gaston is developed with his purpose in mind as the doorman of the second area, exploring the macro-theme of shame and judgment. His characteristics portray the essence of the town and his role in it.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/835ebc5d6e24e0dbca559c79195c8c0da2586292.jpg


There's a hidden house in Clemensburg where Gaston lives, painting portraits, and writing letters to his secret love. 

Discovering this secret adds to the intrigue. You might find it and unravel the mystery of his secret love. For more gossip about men with unibrows, check out The Perfect Pencil; it won't disappoint.

Thank you for your time. If you want to meet other bizarre personalities, they'll be waiting for you in The Perfect Pencil. You can try it right now for free downloading the game demo! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858810/The_Perfect_Pencil/

notes.title: How we make atmospheric depth - Dev Blog #3
notes.content:
Welcome to another Dev Blog! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/490832ffc3f228fedd138a0d3b3d9bdc0402ecdd.gif

Today we’ll give you an inside look into one technology we are using to simulate atmospheric perspective in The Perfect Pencil world.

Firstly, what’s Atmospheric Perspective?

A variety of techniques artists use to simulate the effects the atmosphere has on objects viewed at a distance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/1be581475dd85bd205f47384d48dcdae6cc5555c.jpg

Artists have been using this techniques since the very beginning of the Common Era, and it is heavily featured in many famous paintings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/b96f7027087104162a673a829150d050d2fb48cd.jpg
(Turner - Ancient Rome; Agrippina Landing with the Ashes of Germanicus)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/0cfbfdd251bee4f9cad5eec4e9a3946c491b9618.jpg
(Monet - The Thames below Westminster)


In this post we’ll focus on the coloring technique: far objects are less saturated and shift toward the sky color.

Parallax and blurry


We already use many parallaxing layers and blurrier sprites the farther they are from the gameplay layer. 

To further push the idea of distance, we can shift far objects smoothly toward the sky color, but we need a smart way to do it. 

A shader can automate the whole process!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/e19b0fb11ec281c2930c0faa2331a47f7059fa3e.gif

First we apply and set up the Interpolation Script, which calculates the object distance based on the parameters we choose.

Next we apply the custom Material which is automatically linked to the previously added script.

We can choose any color we want the object to shift to.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/4aa50b733673a6576f65c59661817fe515bba31f.gif

It’s working! the sprite will automatically shift to the color we chose in the Material by moving along the Z axis, according to the min/max parameters we previously set in the script. 

And voila’, we can now quickly apply this process to all objects in the background using the same material to create a nice atmospheric depth effect without breaking a sweat!

We can use this to simulate all sorts of situations! We even started using it to color the foreground!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/f2579239b02524cabbc1ea18e7cbe56af83bce4e.jpg

About performance: to avoid the instancing of the material that will decrease the performance, we used the r channel of sprite renderer color to insert the interpolation value. 

In this way we are able to use only one material without instancing it many times, decreasing the number of draw call :)

notes.title: The Perfect Pencil new trailer and beta announcement!
notes.content:
Hello there!

Today we wanted to show you the new trailer for our game, The Perfect Pencil, but most importantly we’d like to take the opportunity to announce our closed beta!

[previewyoutube=QLAmoICCKXs;full][/previewyoutube]

But most importantly: the closed beta! We invite you all to try The Perfect Pencil for free this weekend, from July 14th to July 17th.

We invite everyone to try The Perfect Pencil for free this weekend, from July 14th to July 17th.

Everyone can register at this link. If you do so, you will receive a Steam Key in you inbox that will allow you to join the closed beta!

For anyone who already played the old demo of the game: this beta is a updated and polished version of our old demo.

We are going through this new beta process because your opinion matters to us, and we would like to learn how we can improve the game even further!


If you want to know more about the game...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/1a1c0cd9122665055032d1855e53b35d2b7cdebd.gif

The Perfect Pencil is a surreal action platformer that tells a tale of personal development and investigates the psychology of fear. Join protagonist John as he awakens in a bizarre hand-drawn kingdom and comes face to face with the terrors that dwell in the last place he’d have thought to look...

The game was born from the need to tell a story about a personal struggle with an anxiety disorder.

Starting from that spark, Studio Cima grew over the years in order to tell that tale and bring The Perfect Pencil to life.

We are now a team of 10, all based in Italy.

Our main inspiration are modern Metroidvanias such as Hollow Knight, and classics such as Zelda and Earthbound.

We are also fascinated by the aesthetics of Magritte, David Lynch and Wes Anderson.

The game is still in development and it is set to be released in 2024 on Steam and Nintendo Switch, with other platforms following.

notes.title: The Healing Attack - Dev Blog #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to our second development update!

Today we want to introduce you to one of the most important features of the game: The Healing Attack.

This is the mechanism that allows you to regain “Will” (health points) on the course of your adventure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/071ad736b6a64d6cfb7e3505fc5503e487815166.gif

The Healing Attack derived directly from the psychological narrative behind the game, and it is the perfect example of how we are trying to create a cohesive structure that binds narrative and gameplay together as much as possible.

This is done in order to craft a complete experience through the tools offered by the video game medium.


The process behind this special attack can ne divided in two steps.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/962373685604ba6faf0096707d1feec0416042fe.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/bed665aa84f661c3fb70e2ab12993eab26036a53.gif

First the players will have to confront the enemies directly by attacking them. This will allow them to gather “Courage” (energy).

This is a clear reference to the core meaning of the game: confronting obstacles to overcome them and proceed on your journey.

Once you have gathered enough “Courage” (energy), you’ll be able to transform it into “Will” (health points).

This is done by charging the Healing Attack and - once the charge phase is completed and the attack is still charged - landing the next blow on an enemy.

This is another instance where the narrative of the game shines through: you have the power to transform your Courage, through action, into Will.  It is said Will that is necessary to keep you standing in the face of adversities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/eb46102e9e04d83244c5616ef2780ad3cf714448.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/ee9f661fad2c9217fc03b27982165b385588874f.png

A small detail that you might find significant is the fact that you’ll be able to gain “Will” (health points) regardless of whether the enemy might be parrying or not. From a narrative standpoint you are not gaining from their loss, but from the act itself of confronting difficulties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/9b9eee78673f0c68e7ac8a8b2844692213550d4a.gif

We believe that this ability will make for a very entertaining gameplay and it will keep players on edge: players will be able to regain health only by exposing themselves to danger when they are at their most vulnerable.  When their Will is low, they need Courage to overcome, survive and continue their journey.

A hidden game mechanic:

There is further use for this ability. What happens if you haven’t taken any damage, and you try the Healing Attack when your halth bar is full? This will unleash a more powerful blow that will deal more damage to your enemies and will allow you to defeat them more easily.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/9949d63c96d07440585205faa50a333da96bacc9.gif

notes.title: The birth of a pencil - Dev Blog #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/24f4506417ab44c3edd7d630357223db40c3dd3d.png



Intro
Hi everyone, I’m Stefano. I’m the mind behind The Perfect Pencil and this is the game's first development update.

I wanted to open up a dialogue about the game’s development and keep you updated with exclusive insights and informations.

If you are interested in knowing more, you can also join our Discord server, where you can engage with the developing team!

This game was born from the need to tell a story. The story was inspired by a personal experience of mine that I believed was worth sharing.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v6grvfQyIRw

The videogame medium was chosen because of its interactive aspect, which is crucial when it comes to involving the players and engaging with them. I wanted to offer a specific type of experience where narrative and gameplay would merge together.

In this game you will be invited to explore a peculiar world, where you can choose your path based on what you observe.

The game started from humble beginnings but I and the team are very proud of the progress we have made since then.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/d1dfa889d663a2211e2aa6169ab94a6d516361c4.gif

[center]Early concepts[/center]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/181bb0c99f0fc8fa5ee905b739da2d1bc956e18e.gif

Actual game alpha



Why a metroidvania?

I chose the action-adventure/metrodvania genre because it offered the possibility to create a complex exploration experience, where the backtracking and the labyrinthine navigation of the environment would help represent the intricacies of the paths of human and psychological development.

While you explore The Perfect Pencil’s surreal kingdom, the gameplay will shift constantly between fights, quests, secrets, encounters and mini-games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/66516003077ef567b0aec9e844c38400b9ddaea6.gif

But I needed to add a second element to this structure in order to create the experience I had in mind: the narrative exploration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/575e7be808ea9b475d5e5bccfa67580841924dd6.gif

Mainly provided by the Analysis ability, this type of exploration will let you uncover useful information, hidden secrets, paths, interactions and choices that will eventually shape your journey and its ending.
This second aspect of the game was also inspired a little bit by old graphic adventure games such as Monkey Island.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/c53aab528566fa98fddaa99b79d0da41d208f1fd.gif




Art direction

Artistically speaking, the game took shape starting from the characters that I used to draw and paint and that always ended up portraying bizarre but meaningful situation.

I really loved the idea that you could interact with them and explore a world that - to me - was like a big painting containing many different layers, each representing something different.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/4c467be3a77da6a346d9259661d491aa91129cee.gif

Since I’ve never painted environments or landscapes, it felt natural for me to take inspiration from personal favourites like Magritte, Lynch and Wes Anderson.

Magritte, the Belgian painter with his surreal but very defined imagery, is one of the main references for the artistic direction of The Perfect Pencil.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/346b71bc5bdc83053eb65f844cf0de1b16fb37c4.jpg

I really liked the sense of familiar mixed with the unexpected that he endeavours to create. This tendency also defines the work of the American director David Lynch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/20d9cf20e2280c9aae15bb7bd2c011f37ab28a4f.jpg

This direction is something very important to me and we are doing our best to recreate it in the game.
Wes Anderson, with his formalism (intended as the opposite of realism), is another big reference I used for the artistic direction of game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/d9ae7aa2d69e5cb088f604f09ca601a6d22d64b5.png

I really admire his visuals and his overall style of communication, because they manage to create a cohesive atmosphere around his storytelling.

This process is especially interesting to me because it approaches themes that are subconscious and out of focus, and it brings them to light, representing them as formalized and standardized processes.
John, the protagonist of the game, is a bizarre young man who fell into this world, and is struggling to find his way out of it.



Our protagonist: John

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/b84607d2f227edfbfbd5edd8e1f2a12df5625113.png

He is portrayed using two peculiar elements:


  A camera in place of his head, which will be the channel for John’s projection and record abilities
  A pencil as a weapon (a sword), which will be used to face difficulties and to survive (thanks to the healing attack) through his journey.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/b85fa6d310e699285dc5f4166152536d9e470814.png


These two elements will have a great importance both for the narrative and the gameplay of the game, they will be instrumental to John’s journey through the kingdom of the white beast.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/dad5e8b37faf1a50cb77b4e268f62c6842ed1991.gif



About Us 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/26371ef6327ef90d28f00c006e92c93c52cc8f8a.gif

The team was born in 2019 and it has slowly grown since then. It is now composed by 10 people: programmers, artists, game designers, a social media manager and a psychologist. Plus an external studio for musics and sound design.

We are all based in Italy, and we love what we are doing!
